source: NOAA NCEI Climate Data Online v2
licence: US federal government public domain; free token required
station_selection: highest CDO datacoverage among stations whose record spans the whole window, ties broken by station id; deterministic and listed in noaa_stations_used.csv
limitation: Station-panel average, not an area-weighted state mean. Long-record stations skew toward airports and larger towns. Adequate as a monthly state covariate; not adequate for a climatological claim.
